user.title: Configure Main Climate
user.description: Select the main climate entity that controls your HVAC system. This will be used to calculate and set the target temperature based on all zones.

zones.title: Configure Zone
zones.description: Configure a heating/cooling zone. Select the temperature sensor and valve switch for this zone. The integration will create a climate entity for this zone.

error.entity_not_found: The selected entity was not found in Home Assistant

init.title: Update Configuration
init.description: Update the configuration for this zone.
